region.text: Harran, Saruj and Edessa in Diyar Mudar

ledger.note: 990: Waththab ibn Sabiq breaks from the Hamdanids and founds the Numayrid emirate at Harran. Infobox 'Independence from Hamdanids: 990'; Saruj 'held from 990 onward'; Edessa 'annexed around 990-1019'.

1007: Waththab takes Raqqa. 'Raqqa: Taken by Waththab in 1007.' [Reviewer me-08-x, 2026-10-19: counterpart was 'local rulers of Raqqa'; the page: 'in 1007, he conquered Raqqa from its Hamdanid governor'.]

1030: Edessa sold to the Byzantines. 'Edessa was sold to the Byzantines in 1030/31. A 1032 treaty left the city in Byzantine hands.' (The Marwanid page has the Marwanids taking Edessa in 1026 and the Byzantines retaking it in 1031.)

1059: Mani' takes al-Rahba and al-Qarqisiyah. 'Mani' extended Numayrid territory to its southernmost point in 1059, taking al-Rahba and al-Qarqisiyah.' The page does not name the previous holder; the Mirdasids, whose Thimal page has Atiyya retaking al-Rahba in 1061, are read as the loser.
1061: the Mirdasids retake al-Rahba. 'In August, Atiyya retook al-Rahba for Thimal' (the Thimal page).
1062: Raqqa lost to the Mirdasids. 'Mani' lost Raqqa to Atiyya ibn Salih in 1062' after the feud with the Banu Kilab that began with Shabib's death in 1039/40.
1081: the Uqaylids take Harran and Saruj. 'In 1081, the Uqaylid emir Muslim ibn Quraysh, backed by the Seljuqs, conquered Harran. The Uqaylids also took Saruj that year.'
1081: the Numayrid emirate ends with the loss of Harran (infobox ended 1081; last mention of the dynasty 1120).

wars.name: Numayrid-Kilab feud over Raqqa
wars.outcome: Shabib's death in 1039/40 'sparked a feud with the Banu Kilab over Raqqa'; Mani' lost Raqqa to Atiyya ibn Salih in 1062.

wars.name: Marwanid-Uqaylid attempt to retake Edessa
wars.outcome: Shabib joined a Marwanid-Uqaylid attempt to retake Edessa in 1036; the Byzantines kept it after peace in 1037.

wars.name: Uqaylid conquest of Harran (1081)
wars.outcome: Muslim ibn Quraysh, backed by the Seljuks, conquered Harran and Saruj.

certainty.note: Tribal emirate of Diyar Mudar defined by its towns (Harran, Saruj, Raqqa, Edessa); no frontiers on the page.

notes: Cliopatria has no Numayrid row. Wikidata id not known; left null. Page area: Diyar Mudar, between Harran, Saruj and Raqqa. Conflicts with the Mirdasid pages (see mirdasid-dynasty): the Numayrid page has Raqqa Numayrid 1007-1062 with a Kilab feud from 1039/40; the Thimal and Mirdasid pages have Salih holding Raqqa by 1022 and Thimal inheriting it from his wife's brother-in-law Shabib in 1039/40 and making it his capital; unresolved, each dossier follows its page. The Marwanid page has the Marwanids taking Edessa in 1026 and losing it in 1031; this page has the Numayrids selling it in 1030/31 after annexing it c. 990-1019. Not written as events: Fatimid vassalage from 1037 (Shabib shifted 1037-38), Abbasid allegiance from c. 1060 (Numayrid is the vassal; the suzerains' dossiers should carry it), Qal'at Ja'bar sold by Mani' to al-Dizbari and recovered after his death in 1041 (sale undated), Sinn Ibn Utayr near Samosata (held until the Crusaders took it in 1118; the last mention of the dynasty is 1120). Gazetteer names needed: Saruj, Harran-region, Qal'at Ja'bar, Samosata.
